explication: Mermaid ASCII accepts diagrams through a CLI or web form, detects the diagram type, parses it, and returns a text rendering. The main supported domains are flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and entity-relationship diagrams; graph rendering also supports width-aware compact retries. The graph distinguishes the documented entry points and domain stages. Internal layout details and some web-template interactions are not fully evidenced by the supplied excerpts, so they are not expanded into speculative connections.
